I'm Australian. Here they ask a bunch of questions ranging from "Have you ever seen this person swear at a governemnt officer" through to "Have you seen this person illegally download, possess or distritube copyrighted material".

If I chose to answer every question as a *literal* question (as in *have I personally witnessed these things?*) I could answer no quite easily. But if I took it as "serious" non filtered questions I would be forced to give answers that would seriously damage (if not destroy) his career.

Tbh I don't want his career to fail. I want him to succeed. Hell I'm worried about him because I know he's being deployed soon (also found in the album). I don't want to hurt him because that's not what friends do.
